description: This is a test module for the /auth/register endpoint in a FastAPI project. It contains integration tests that verify password validation rules, duplicate email handling, and proper registration behavior using an in-memory SQLite database.

methods.name: using_inmemory_db()
methods.description: Context manager that sets up an in-memory SQLite database environment for testing purposes, ensuring a clean state by setting environment variables, clearing cached settings, and creating database tables.

methods.name: _client()
methods.description: Helper function that creates and returns a new FastAPI TestClient instance configured with the app.

methods.name: str _password_of_bytes(n: int)
methods.description: Utility function to generate a string of 'a' characters of specified length, used to test password length validation.

methods.name: test_register_with_valid_password_returns_201()
methods.description: Test that verifies registration with valid password returns status code 201 and correct response data.

methods.name: test_register_with_7_chars_returns_400()
methods.description: Test that ensures a password less than 8 characters results in a 400 response with an appropriate error message.

methods.name: test_register_with_1000_chars_returns_201()
methods.description: Test that confirms very long passwords (1000 characters) are accepted and result in a successful registration.

methods.name: test_register_duplicate_email_returns_409()
methods.description: Test that duplicate email registration attempts return status code 409 and an appropriate error message.
